entries.name: War Pigs
entries.comment: "War Pigs - 2009 Remaster" by Black Sabbath on "Paranoid". JUDGEMENT CALL: Walk-on tape of Black Sabbath's War Pigs. The band pass only has "War Pigs - Charity Version" (Judas Priest with Ozzy Osbourne, 2025). "Charity Version" is not a marker (only "‹year› Version" is), so it is not a candidate and the fallback picks Sabbath's studio original on "Paranoid" (2009 Remaster). Matches what is actually played. If "‹anything› Version" were stripped, the charity single would be found under the band instead.

entries.name: You've Got Another Thing Comin'
entries.comment: "You've Got Another Thing Comin'" by Judas Priest on "Screaming For Vengeance (Expanded Edition)". "Screaming For Vengeance (Expanded Edition)" and "Screaming For Vengeance" are both dated 1982 (year only) and both albums, so Spotify's order decides (MATCH-8 tie). Both are the studio recording.
